subject: Introducing the Atlas No. 03
preheader: A quieter way to keep time. Meet our new everyday automatic.

content.text: Introducing No. 03. An automatic watch for the moments you would rather take slowly.

Brushed steel.
Warm ivory.
Entirely your time.

Less on the dial.
More in the day.
No extra hands to chase. No detail asking for your attention. Just a clear ivory dial, a brushed case and a movement that follows your rhythm.

“Good design gives you a little
less to think about.”
A note from the Atlas design desk
Make room for a slower minute.
See the details, choose your strap and find the version that feels like yours.
